title: Each feature located
description: Each feature has a geometry. A feature without one (a JSON null geometry, RFC 7946 section 3.2, or a Shapefile null shape, shape type 0 in the ESRI Shapefile Technical Description) is valid but unlocated, and fails. The example row is the feature's 1-based position in the file.

words.template: {count} features have no geometry, the first at {first}.
